title: Rustic Christmas Digital Paper
author: ElaneDesign
description:
Immerse yourself in the rustic charm of the Boho Christmas Digital Paper Pack, a compelling fusion of Boho aesthetics and warm holiday sentiments. This digital assortment showcases 10 JPEG format seamless digital papers, boasting impressive specifications of 12″ x 12″, 3600 x 3600 pixels and fine resolution of 300 dpi. 
Each paper breathes life into a classic rustic Christmas theme, with whimsical Boho Christmas influences and vintage rustic Christmas scrapbook elements. Adorn your creations with a winter pinecone digital paper, quirky boho Christmas background, or a soothing neutral Christmas seamless pattern. 
Indulge in the warmth of cozy holiday digital papers or chic woodland Christmas printable papers. Our pack offers a Hygge Christmas aesthetic background, brimming with comfort and harmony. Venture into minimalist natural Christmas wrapping paper designs or bath in the glowing warmth of unique Christmas pine and candle clipart backgrounds. 
Revel in modern farmhouse Christmas themes, beautifully tied together with gorgeous beige and sage Christmas papers. This digital scrapbook paper pack includes winter greenery seamless patterns that bring a breath of fresh air to any project. 
The rustic pinecone pattern paper adds a touch of countryside charm. Delicate shades and patterns in our cottagecore Christmas designs can transform your work into art. Neutral winter printable backgrounds layer effortlessly, making your projects pop, while our digital paper pack is perfect for scrapbooking enthusiasts.
Delight in 12×12 inch papers with a high-definition 300 DPI resolution and instant download feature. Get crafty with these digital texture sets that also includes crafting supplies, making our collection great for commercial use too.
